in_marathi.name: Ekambari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Ekam (Oneness)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekambari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekambari is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Ekam' which means 'Oneness'. In Hindu mythology, Ekambari is the Goddess of Oneness, representing the idea of unity and wholeness. She is often depicted carrying a pot of rice or grain on her head, symbolizing abundance and nourishment.
